versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֔ה וָאַעֲמִ֖יד הַדְּלָת֑וֹת וַיִּפָּֽקְד֛וּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: Now when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
controles.kjv: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
controles.livre: Sucedeu, pois, que, quando o muro já havia sido edificado, e já tinha posto as portas, e sido estabelecidos os porteiros, os cantores e os Levitas,

versos.hebraico: וָאֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת־חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗י וְאֶת־חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַבִּירָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּי־הוּא֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְיָרֵ֥א אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the castle, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
controles.kjv: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
controles.livre: Mandei o meu irmão Hanani, e Hananias, chefe do palácio de Jerusalém (porque era um homem fiel e temente a Deus, mais que muitos),

versos.hebraico: ויאמר לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַד־חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָת֖וֹת וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָר֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
controles.kjv: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Não se abram as portas de Jerusalém até que o sol aqueça; e enquanto ainda estiverem presentes, fechem as portas, e as trancai. E ponham-se guardas dos moradores de Jerusalém, cada um em sua guarda, e cada um diante de sua casa.

versos.hebraico: וְהָעִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֨יִם֙ וּגְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהָעָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ וְאֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם׃

controles.web: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.
controles.kjv: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
controles.livre: E a cidade era espaçosa e grande, porém pouca gente havia dentro dela, e as casas ainda não haviam sido reconstruídas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַי֙ אֶל־לִבִּ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֞ה אֶת־הַחֹרִ֧ים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֛ים וְאֶת־הָעָ֖ם לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽאֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַיַּ֨חַשׂ֙ הָעוֹלִ֣ים בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֔ה וָאֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found written therein:
controles.kjv: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
controles.livre: Então Deus pôs em meu coração que juntasse os nobres, os oficiais, e o povo, para que fossem registrados pela ordem de suas genealogias; e achei o livro da genealogia dos que haviam subido antes, e achei nele escrito o seguinte :

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְלִיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃

controles.web: These are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city;
controles.kjv: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos da província que subiram do cativeiro, dos que foram levados por Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e que voltaram a Jerusalém e a Judá, cada um à sua cidade;

versos.hebraico: הַבָּאִ֣ים עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
controles.kjv: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
controles.livre: Os quais vieram com Zorobabel, Jesua, Neemias, Azarias, Raamias, Naamani, Mardoqueu, Bilsã, Misperete, Bigvai, Neum, Baaná. Este é o número dos homens do povo de Israel:

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.livre: Os filhos de Parós, dois mil cento e setenta e dois;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.livre: Os filhos de Sefatias, trezentos e setenta e dois;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Paate-Moabe, dos filhos de Jesua e de Joabe, dois mil oitocentos e dezoito;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Azgade, dois mil seiscentos e vinte e dois;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Bigvai, dois mil e sessenta e sete;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Bezai, trezentos e vinte e quatro;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Harife, cento e doze;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Gibeom, noventa e cinco;

controles.kjv: The men of Beth–lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
controles.livre: Os homens de Belém e de Netofá, cento e oitenta e oito;

versos.hebraico: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס

controles.livre: Os homens de Quiriate-Jearim, Cefira e Beerote, setecentos e quarenta e três;

controles.livre: Os homens de Ramá e de Geba, seiscentos e vinte e um;

controles.kjv: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
controles.livre: Os homens de Micmás, cento e vinte e dois;

controles.livre: Os homens da outra Nebo, cinquenta e dois;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Harim, trezentos e vinte;

controles.livre: Os filhos de Jericó, trezentos e quarenta e cinco;

controles.kjv: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lode, de Hadide, e Ono, setecentos vinte e um;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃פ

controles.kjv: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Senaá, três mil novecentos e trinta.

versos.hebraico: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.
controles.kjv: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
controles.livre: Os sacerdotes: os filhos de Jedaías, da casa de Jesua, novecentos e setenta e três;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.
controles.kjv: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Imer, mil e cinquenta e dois;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
controles.kjv: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Pasur, mil duzentos quarenta e sete;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃פ

controles.web: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.
controles.kjv: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Harim, mil dez e sete.

versos.hebraico: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י לְהוֹדְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah, seventy-four.
controles.kjv: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
controles.livre: Os levitas: os filhos de Jesua, de Cadmiel, dos filhos de Hodeva, setenta e quatro.

versos.hebraico: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred forty-eight.
controles.kjv: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
controles.livre: Os cantores: os filhos de Asafe, cento e quarenta e oito.

versos.hebraico: הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי־שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי־טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, one hundred thirty-eight.
controles.kjv: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
controles.livre: Os porteiros: os filhos de Salum, os filhos de Ater, os filhos de Talmom, os filhos de Acube, os filhos de Hatita, os filhos de Sobai, cento e trinta e oito.

versos.hebraico: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־צִחָ֥א בְנֵי־חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
controles.kjv: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
controles.livre: Os servos do templo: os filhos de Zia, os filhos de Hasufa, os filhos de Tabaote,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי־סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃

controles.web: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
controles.kjv: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Queros, os filhos de Sia, os filhos de Padom,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי׃

controles.web: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
controles.kjv: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lebana, os filhos de Hagaba, os filhos de Salmai,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי־גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי־גָֽחַר׃

controles.web: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
controles.kjv: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Hanã, os filhos de Gidel, os filhos de Gaar,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקוֹדָֽא׃

controles.web: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
controles.kjv: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Reaías, os filhos de Rezim, os filhos de Necoda,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי־עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ׃

controles.web: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah.
controles.kjv: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Gazão, os filhos de Uzá, os filhos de Paseia,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי־מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י נפושסים׃

controles.web: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
controles.kjv: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Besai, os filhos de Meunim, os filhos de Nefusesim,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי־חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃

controles.web: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
controles.kjv: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Baquebuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי־מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃

controles.web: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
controles.kjv: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Baslite, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־תָֽמַח׃

controles.web: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
controles.kjv: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Tamá,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃

controles.web: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
controles.kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Nesias, os filhos de Hatifa.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־סוֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃

controles.web: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
controles.kjv: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
controles.livre: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão: os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Perida,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי־דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃

controles.web: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
controles.kjv: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jaala, os filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel,

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן׃

controles.web: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Amon.
controles.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de Poquerete-Hazebaim, os filhos de Amom.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃פ

controles.web: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.
controles.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
controles.livre: Todos os servos do templo, e filhos dos servos de Salomão, trezentos e noventa e dois.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעוֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְאִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃

controles.web: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel:
controles.kjv: And these were they which went up also from Tel–melah, Tel–haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
controles.livre: Também estes subiram de Tel-Melá, Tel-Harsa, Querube, Adom, e Imer, porém não puderam mostrar a casa de seus pais, nem sua linhagem, se eram de Israel:

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty-two.
controles.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e quarenta e dois.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃

controles.web: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
controles.kjv: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
controles.livre: E dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, o qual tomara mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e chamou-se pelo nome delas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃

controles.web: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.
controles.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
controles.livre: Estes buscaram seu registro de genealogias, porém não se achou; por isso, como impuros, foram excluídos do sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתוּמִּֽים׃

controles.web: The governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, until there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
controles.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
controles.livre: E o governador lhes disse que não comessem das coisas mais santas, até que houvesse sacerdote com Urim e Tumim.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
controles.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
controles.livre: Toda esta congregação junta era quarenta e dois mil trezentos e sessenta,

versos.hebraico: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: besides their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and they had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.
controles.kjv: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
controles.livre: Exceto seus servos e suas servas, que eram sete mil trezentos e trinta e sete; e tinham duzentos e quarenta e cinco cantores e cantoras.

versos.hebraico: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑הס חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

controles.web: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
controles.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
controles.livre: Os camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; asnos, seis mil setecentos e vinte.

versos.hebraico: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.
controles.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.
controles.livre: E alguns dos chefes das famílias fizeram doações para a obra. O governador deu para o tesouro mil dracmas de ouro, cinquenta bacias, e quinhentas trinta vestes sacerdotais.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
controles.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
controles.livre: E alguns dos chefes das famílias deram para o tesouro da obra, vinte mil dracmas de ouro, e duas mil e duzentas libras de prata.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ

controles.web: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.
controles.kjv: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.
controles.livre: E o que o resto do povo deu foi vinte mil dracmas de ouro, duas mil libras de prata, e sessenta e sete vestes sacerdotais.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
controles.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
controles.livre: E os sacerdotes, os Levitas, e os porteiros, os cantores, os do povo, os servos do templo, e todo Israel, habitaram em suas cidades.E vindo o mês sétimo, estando os filhos de Israel em suas cidades,
